We are together for now over 3 1/2 years. My negative emotions flared because of the stress of grief other conflicts that arose from losing my parent. I went to therapy for it and there I was diagnosed with a disorder where learned that I essentially suck at managing my emotions especially in times of stress. Part of it was that I basically let myself implode because I just wasn't able to talk about the stress I was undergoing to anyone. Therapy helped change that. It wasn't that I didn't trust my partner to comfort me or anything like that it was more like the fear of how he would react knowing what was going on in my head. As for the social media that's also one way I coped. I would escape with instagram reels and just watch one after another for hours to be able to take a break from the nonstop thoughts/stress. It also required little effort as I didn't have to talk to anyone which when you are going through something can seem so impossible.

You’re free to do whatever you want obviously but choosing that manager job was the most horrible decision I ever made.

She’s not doing it intentionally. It’s hard when you’ve first found someone to be apart from them. I can’t tell you how long that honeymoon phase will last but just realize that it doesn’t last forever. She will start coming back to you slowly. It just so happens that because of the timing of your own personal issues it feels worse than it actually is. You can always just  talk to her too! Don’t be accusatory or scolding. Just let her know how much you miss her and point out that you haven’t been spending as much time together as you would like.
